query: PEP 703 page that proposes making the CPython GIL optional
answer:
**PEP 703 – Making the Global Interpreter Lock Optional in CPython** 的规范页是：

https://peps.python.org/pep-0703/

抓取结果中的页面标题为 “PEP 703 – Making the Global Interpreter Lock Optional in CPython | peps.python.org”，最终 URL 为 `https://peps.python.org/pep-0703/`。页头信息：Author 为 Sam Gross，Sponsor 为 Łukasz Langa，Status 为 Final，Type 为 Standards Track，Created 为 09-Jan-2023，Python-Version 为 3.13。Resolution 为 24-Oct-2023。

摘要原句：

> This PEP proposes adding a build configuration (`--disable-gil`) to CPython to let it run Python code without the global interpreter lock and with the necessary changes needed to make the interpreter thread-safe.

同页 Steering Council 说明原句：

> The Steering Council accepts PEP 703, but with clear proviso: that the rollout be gradual and break as little as possible, and that we can roll back any changes that turn out to be too disruptive – which includes potentially rolling back all of PEP 703 entirely if necessary (however unlikely or undesirable we expect that to be).

同页还注明本文现为 historical document，现行说明在：

https://docs.python.org/3/howto/free-threading-python.html
